title: The Painting Bleeds
description: A man in a dark suit stands in a dimly lit room holding a flashlight and an axe, shining light onto a large ornate painting. The painting depicts a bloody zombie-like figure with a halo of barbed wire, from which blood and viscera are physically spilling out into the real room, pooling on the floor.
prompt: A tense noir scene in a dimly lit blue-toned room with rain visible through a skylight. A man in a suit holds a lit flashlight and bloody axe, illuminating a massive gilded painting on the wall. The painting shows a gruesome decaying zombie in a suit with a barbed wire crown, emerging from an exit door background. Blood and torn flesh realistically drip and spill from the canvas onto the floor and desk, creating a horrifying breach between art and reality.
